definitions.explanation: Describes a physical sensation of discomfort, especially nausea.
Describes something that causes psychological discomfort or revulsion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}ったら→乗る：00511_noru⟧{気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}く⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I felt nauseous after getting on the boat.

examples.japanese: {食|た}べすぎて{気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: I ate too much and feel sick.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二日酔|ふつかよ}い→二日酔い：08331_futsukayoi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}くて⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{食|た}べられなかった→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I had a hangover and felt so nauseous from the morning that I couldn't eat anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧、{気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}い！
⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{笑|わら}い→笑う：00685_warau⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧、⟦なんか→なんか：05309_nanka⟧{気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: There's something creepy about the way that person laughs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧べったりついた⟦カビ→カビ：07055_kabi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}かった。
examples.english: The mold stuck all over the wall was disgusting.

notes:
FORMS:
{気持|きも}ち (feeling) + ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (bad)
- {気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}く⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - not unpleasant (negative)
- {気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}くて - unpleasant and... (te-form)
- {気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}かった - was unpleasant (past)

SHORTENED FORMS:
- キモい / ⟦きもい→キモい：04754_kimoi⟧ - gross, creepy (slang, casual)
- キモっ！- Gross! (exclamation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気持|きも}ちいい→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧ / {気持|きも}ち⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ - feels good, pleasant

REGISTER:
{気持|きも}ち{悪|わる}い is neutral; キモい is slang and can be offensive.
